named_method: Experimental-style Floquet-Bloch state analysis in graphene using tr-ARPES observables
definition: Identify energy-momentum replica bands displaced by approximately integer multiples of the pump photon energy from the main Dirac dispersion.
Compare pump-on and pump-off spectra to isolate driven-state spectral weight changes.
Preserve polarization-angle structure in at least one quantitative artifact.
Interpret sideband intensity anisotropy in terms of matrix-element/final-state (Volkov/LAPE-like) effects only to the extent supported by data.
assumptions: Provided HDF5 angle-indexed pump-on spectra approximate the key driven snapshots even though no full 4D time cube per angle is present.
Processed JSON band positions are valid extracted features from the raw spectra.
invariants: Replica energies must be symmetrically offset from the main band by about one photon energy.
Main claims must be traceable to saved spectra-derived metrics and figures.
non_negotiable_steps: Compute or verify replica offsets from actual workspace data.
Generate energy-momentum plots from raw spectra.
Export polarization-dependent metrics and fit summary.
State limitations where data do not fully resolve Volkov/Floquet separation.
